governing_outcome: In native ChatGPT sessions, the Agent—not the user—must carry the routine responsibility to assess the required execution depth on every selected-context turn, proactively escalating to current UAOS DeepTask/cognition/evolution mechanisms when warranted, while simple tasks remain lightweight and repository authority remains singular.

UAOS single-owner cognition architecture requires session/host surfaces to activate canonical mechanisms rather than copy their detailed semantics.

architecture_candidates.falsification: Would only be acceptable if native-session authority already required independent every-turn non-problem depth classification; repository evidence showed it did not.
Would only be acceptable if duplication could not drift from repository authority; bootstrap-only invariants and Codex review showed this would create a stale second source.
Would only be necessary if DeepTask semantic activation did not already exist; src/uaos/kernel/deep_task.py already provided it.

Reject if it duplicated cognition ownership, made simple tasks permanently deep, violated existing bootstrap/no-op invariants, exceeded account instruction limits, or overclaimed native-host physical enforcement. Candidate tests and independent review found none of those conditions after repair.
